commitments.detail: Project handoffs will be conducted via detailed documents and written emails.
Responses to handoff documents should be provided within 24 hours.
This operating plan will be in effect for the next 12 weeks.
Any issues arising from the handoff process should be addressed through a formal meeting.
Exchange detailed documents via written email with a 48-hour response window.
Schedule formal meetings to address issues within 72 hours of notice.
to attend a mediation session to discuss and agree on a new handoff process
Both parties agree to participate in a mediation session facilitated by HR to address the issues with project handoffs.
